svg.title: Numbered Drosophila chromosomes at metaphase I
svg.desc: The reference complement lists derivative chromosome 2 (4), derivative X (1), normal chromosome 2 (2), and normal Y (3). The four replicated chromosomes form a quadrivalent. The left pole connects to 1 and 4; the right connects to 2 and 3. Each centromere belt connects both sister chromatids.
